description: IPC for the loopback backend origin. The shell deliberately loads the web client from http://127.0.0.1:<port> (same-origin cookies, signaling WebSocket, no CORS), which is a *remote* origin as far as Tauri is concerned: without this capability the IPC bridge is not injected, so window.__TAURI__.core.invoke is missing and the app silently loses get_window_handle, the overlay-window commands and the updater. Scoped to the loopback host only.
